WITH hand_counts AS (
  SELECT 
    COALESCE(player.throws, '') as throws,
    COUNT(*) as tally
  FROM player_award
  INNER JOIN player ON player_award.player_id = player.player_id
  GROUP BY COALESCE(player.throws, '')
),
hand_shares AS (
  SELECT 
    throws,
    tally,
    tally * 1.0 / SUM(tally) OVER () as share
  FROM hand_counts
),
avg_share_calc AS (
  SELECT AVG(share) as avg_share
  FROM hand_shares
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT 
    throws, 
    tally, 
    share,
    (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_calc) as global_avg
  FROM hand_shares
  WHERE share > (SELECT avg_share FROM avg_share_calc)
)
SELECT
  SUM(tally) as total_of_tallies,
  AVG(share) as average_share,
  AVG(share - global_avg) as avg_excess
FROM above_avg
